primary.protocol: MTMT multi-scale Mip-NeRF 360 (train_ms.py + mtmt_360.sh), the paper's headline anti-aliasing claim
primary.baseline: gsplat (classic 3DGS, 0.3 px dilation) trained in the same exp on the same mipnerf360-ms data with the same 1x duplication; no pre-existing baseline run
primary.summary: python3 tools/multiscale_summary.py --exp <exp>  (per scene: mean over views per scale, then mean over 1x/2x/4x/8x)
primary.success_criterion: our gain over the gsplat baseline per scale vs the paper's gain over its multi-scale 3DGS row; largest at 8x
fidelity_gaps: --sample_more_highres approximated by 3 hard-linked copies of each 1x train frame: P(1x)=0.50 vs official 0.475 (with-replacement sampling, not a without-replacement stack)
runtime: white background (official black), valid-conv SSIM, densify after optimizer step
primary.resources: RAM: all frames held as float32 on CPU, ~8 GB/run garden, ~15 GB/run counter

secondary.protocol: STST single-scale no-regression check (not the claim test)
